slice: Require complete-packet verification before downstream consumers can read retained receipt or manifest content.

verification.method: Node test runner against the exact committed module logic reproduced in an isolated runtime

claim_ceiling: Source, deterministic local test execution, and repository persistence only. No Vercel deployment, browser runtime, audio audibility, physical-device observation, or peer execution is claimed.

rollback.strategy: Revert the test commit, then revert the implementation commit.
